screen.takeit.server.note: All modes ignore case; the server name must match exactly; ports never take part; singleplayer always keys on the world folder.
screen.takeit.server.rule.server_name: Match the name shown in the server list: the same name means the same server even on a different domain. Falls back to the base domain when the name is blank.
screen.takeit.server.rule.base_domain: Compare only the main domain (last two labels): mc.example.com and play.example.com count as the same server, so subdomains do not matter. A bare IP is compared as a whole. Public suffixes such as example.co.uk get merged too aggressively.
screen.takeit.server.rule.full_domain: Compare the full host name: any subdomain difference is a different server — the strictest of the three modes.
